Simulation budget is exhausted, so this action cannot be checked here. The best result so far is iteration 5 (score 1.960), and it should be kept as the deliverable.

At tt only `ripple_settled` fails (13.1 mV against a 10 mV limit). Undershoot is close to its limit (243 mV against 250 mV), and line regulation and PSRR have little margin. The residual ripple 7–10 µs after the step is most likely the slow Rz–Cz pole-zero doublet still settling, not a fast unstable mode. Moving the zero up (lower `wz_ratio`) should shorten that tail. A larger `Cgc` should add damping at the pass gate without adding undershoot. My analytic models for regulation and line regulation are known to be wrong (off by about 1000×), so these steers come from the simulated results, not the predictions.
